forge-rs.description: Layer 4 code-enrichment engine — forge_enrich, forge_reflect, forge_drift, forge_validate. Served without auth on loopback (forge mcp --no-auth); the server refuses --no-auth on a non-loopback bind.

args: for w in "$HOME/.local/bin/liter-llm-mcp" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/scripts/liter-llm-mcp-launch.sh"; do [ -f "$w" ] && exec bash "$w"; done; echo "liter-llm MCP launcher not found: run scripts/install-binaries.sh from the Prometheus skill pack" >&2; exit 127
liter-llm.description: Multi-model routing proxy — 22 MCP tools across 140+ providers with per-phase model class routing (default config routes through the local openai-proxy at :8181). Started through the liter-llm-mcp launcher, which loads ~/.prometheus/kbd/secrets.env first.

prometheus-knowledge.description: Karpathy LLM Knowledge Base — knowledge_ingest, knowledge_focus, knowledge_search, knowledge_lint, knowledge_get

surreal-memory.description: Global distributed memory state server — knowledge graph, scoped memory, TaskStreams, mindmaps, Graph-RAG traversal, hybrid search

sycophancy-correction.description: Detect and correct sycophantic patterns (S-01 through S-08) in prompts, completions, agent descriptors, and PMPO reflect outputs
